meta.name: Chememan Design System
meta.note: tokens.json is THE authoritative machine-readable source. tokens.css and tailwind.preset.js are hand-mirrored from this file — if you edit one, edit all three or they silently drift.
meta.source: Live Chememan Supply Chain web app (https://sc-qas.chememan.com, QAS/staging), extracted 2026-08-15. Raw evidence in reference/sc-qas-extracted/.
meta.supersedes: The prior CI-book-derived palette (forest/blue/amber glassmorphism) is fully preserved, unchanged, in brand-ci-legacy.css / see README.md for when to use it instead.
meta.scope: Bootstrap 5.3.2 admin-app UI — navbar, sidebar, cards, tables, forms, badges, login

color._note: Variable names green/teal/light/lighter are copied verbatim from the app's own :root block in site.css.

green.role: Primary — navbar bg, card-header bg, active states, links, focus

teal.role: Hover / gradient partner / focus border. Lighter than green, not darker.

light.role: Declared in the app's :root but NOT rendered — only consumed by the `.sidebar .nav-link` rule in site.css, and no element carries a bare class="sidebar" (the real sidebar is <nav id="sidebar">), so that rule matches zero elements. Real sidebar hover is color.surface.50 (#f8f9fa).

lighter.role: Declared in the app's :root but NOT consumed by any rule in site.css at all.

green-ramp._note: 50/100/400/500 observed (lighter/light/teal/green). 200/300/600/700/800/900 derived, not observed in app.

surface._note: Every background/border hex actually used in the shared layout, site.css, and inline styles. Grouped by step number, NOT a strict light->dark ordering: 25 and 200 are green-tinted (200 is the exact layout.sidebar-active value, reused deliberately) and 200 is actually LIGHTER than 150. Renamed from 'neutral' (2026-08-15) because that label implied pure grays in strict order, which was false. color.neutral below is a compatibility alias with identical values.

0.role: table zebra odd row, sidebar bg

50.role: #mainContent bg, sidebar nav-link hover, sticky header bg

100.role: sidebar-header/divider border, readonly & disabled field bg

200.role: sidebar-active bg, section-title bg (Po_Create) — green-tinted, duplicates layout.sidebar-active, lighter than 150

300.role: sidebar border-right, #sidebarToggle border, nav-tabs bottom border, sticky header border

500.role: placeholder text, empty date/datetime text, sidebar-section-label

600.role: muted text, nav-tabs idle link, #sidebarToggle icon

700.role: form-label, sidebar nav-link text, table thead text

800.role: filled input text, CLOSED badge — darkest neutral the app actually uses for text

900.role: pure black — badge fg on BOOKEDNOTPRO / LOADED only

neutral._note: Compatibility alias of color.surface — identical values, kept so anything already reading color.neutral.* doesn't break. Use color.surface.* in new code.

status._note: These are Bootstrap 5's own named contextual colors. The app's 10 shipment-status badges each reuse one verbatim. See components/COMPONENTS.md for the literal SC status -> generic color mapping.

login-bg.role: Real — body background on the login page

login-header.role: NOT used by the real login header, which is a flat brand.green fill. Only backs the dead .login-card-header rule in site.css (matches zero elements — see components/COMPONENTS.md § Login card).

layout._note: Verbatim :root block shared by every authenticated page's layout <style> block.

font._note: CRITICAL: the app declares NO font-family anywhere (0 occurrences across every dumped page + site.css). It renders in the Bootstrap 5.3.2 default system-font stack. Do not add a custom webfont here — see typography/TYPOGRAPHY.md for the opt-in FC Minimal path.

family.system-stack: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"

size._note: Every rem size observed across the dumps + site.css, smallest to largest, with what uses it.

h5.use: unstyled <h5> (e.g. "Sign In" login heading, modal titles) — inherited Bootstrap 5.3.2 default, not declared anywhere in the app's own CSS

h4.use: unstyled <h4> (e.g. list-page headers like "PO List") — inherited Bootstrap 5.3.2 default, not declared anywhere in the app's own CSS

border._hairline_note: The app's other, thinner border rule (e.g. #poStickyHeader) — don't reach for border.nav-tabs (2px) where the real rule is 1px.
